prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>: a Chinese man about 26 years old with a lean but healthy build, natural short black hair, a clean-shaven face, straight dark eyebrows and fresh, ordinary, approachable features, wearing a plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under an unbuttoned dark blue-gray casual overshirt, black straight-leg trousers and white sneakers.

summary:
[reference generation] Lit by the open drinks refrigerator, <Subject 1> scans the shelf, stops on a row of silver-blue beer cans with quiet recognition, takes one and lowers it naturally to his side.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his face, natural short black hair, straight dark eyebrows, lean build, plain gray crew-neck T-shirt and unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture and soft highlight roll-off, in clean cool-white light with crisp silver-blue highlights.
[Shot 1] A medium close-up frames <Subject 1> from the chest up, seen from inside the open drinks refrigerator so that he faces the shelves through the open glass door; the edge of the door and the blurred tops of bottles frame the left and lower edges. Cool white refrigerator light falls evenly on his face. At the start his eyes scan the shelves from left to right at a calm pace, with one blink. His gaze stops on a row of silver-blue beer cans with blue tops at eye level just below the camera and holds there for a moment: his eyebrows rise very slightly and the corners of his mouth soften into a faint closed-mouth expression of quiet recognition, not a grin. His eyes move to one specific can, he reaches forward with his right hand, takes it in a clean, ordinary movement, glances down at it once in his hand, and lowers it naturally to his side, out of the bottom of the frame, while his eyes return to the shelf for a moment. He never presents the can to the camera and never looks into the lens. Both eyes stay level and symmetrical and aim at the same target; his facial proportions stay unchanged. Behind him the store aisle is blurred into soft shapes of white and color. The camera holds a static shot. His lips stay closed; he does not speak. There is no text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: A steady refrigeration hum, the light clink of the can leaving the metal shelf, and quiet store ambience.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
